description: Land Acquisition - Nivithigala, Nivithigala D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2115/55 of 23.03.2019 Mulatiyana D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific notices about acquiring particular land parcels (including lot numbers, descriptions, extents, and locations) for public purposes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
